description: This file defines the HIDL interface and implementation wrapper for the Android graphics buffer producer, specifically the WGraphicBufferProducer class template, including method declarations for buffer management, connection, and querying functions.

classes.name: TWGraphicBufferProducer
classes.description: A template class that wraps a base class to implement the IGraphicBufferProducer interface, providing methods for buffer request, queue, detach, attach, connect, disconnect, and querying buffer states.

methods.name: requestBuffer
methods.description: Requests a buffer for a given slot and returns an AnwBuffer along with status.

methods.name: setMaxDequeuedBufferCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of dequeued buffers.

methods.name: setAsyncMode
methods.description: Enables or disables asynchronous mode.

methods.name: dequeueBuffer
methods.description: Dequeues a buffer with specified width, height, format, usage, and timestamp info.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from a slot.

methods.name: detachNextBuffer
methods.description: Detaches the next buffer available.

methods.name: attachBuffer
methods.description: Attaches a buffer to the producer.

methods.name: queueBuffer
methods.description: Queues a buffer for display.

methods.name: cancelBuffer
methods.description: Cancels a queued buffer.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Queries information about the buffer producer.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a producer listener with specified API and control mode.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the producer from the specified API.

methods.name: setSidebandStream
methods.description: Sets a sideband stream handle.

methods.name: allocateBuffers
methods.description: Allocates buffers with specified dimensions and format.

methods.name: allowAllocation
methods.description: Allows or disallows buffer allocation.

methods.name: setGenerationNumber
methods.description: Sets the generation number for buffers.

methods.name: getConsumerName
methods.description: Retrieves the consumer name.

methods.name: setSharedBufferMode
methods.description: Enables or disables shared buffer mode.

methods.name: setAutoRefresh
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-refresh.

methods.name: setDequeueTimeout
methods.description: Sets the dequeue timeout in nanoseconds.

methods.name: getLastQueuedBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the last queued buffer, fence, and transform matrix.

methods.name: getFrameTimestamps
methods.description: Retrieves frame timestamp information.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Retrieves a unique identifier for the buffer producer.
